beat-answer.note: Four-beats set: state the recommendation. Same Signal Indigo.

beat-explain.note: Four-beats set: justify it. Solid only, never gradient, never on scoring.

beat-connect.note: Four-beats set: tie it to the business. Highest-value beat; most saturated accent.

beat-above.note: Four-beats set: above and beyond. Distinct in context from Developing Amber; never share a surface.

display.purpose: Hero and top-of-screen H1 only. Space Grotesk, the one place fluid sizing is allowed.

headline.purpose: Section H2s. Space Grotesk, fixed scale.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and UI prose. Inter, 65–75ch cap.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase kickers and micro-labels. Ration these — not on every section.

metric.purpose: Big numeric data: rubric weights, percentages, pace.

microlabel.purpose: Dense mono data badges at 9-11px (most points, term index, Definition). Never for prose; kept at 600 weight to stay crisp.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Default soft seat under a light-mode surface.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover/active only; pairs with a 2px upward translate.

shadows.name: hero-media
shadows.purpose: The one indigo-tinted shadow, under the demo video.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: Loader wave and reveals; exponential ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: duration-ui
motion.purpose: Default state transition — hover, focus, tab switch.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → crossfade or slow pulse
motion.purpose: Every animation needs this path; essential loaders keep a slow pulse, never freeze.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per view — generate, submit, start.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; font: 600 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternative action beside a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; background: #fff; color: #334155; font: 600 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f8fafc; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The raised task surface. Flat at rest, lifts on hover. Never nest cards.
components.html:
Three steps, start to score

Prep against the clock, present it live, then read exactly where you stood.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,23,42,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { font: 600 1.0625rem/1.3 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { font: 400 0.9375rem/1.6 Inter, sans-serif; color: #475569; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Slate-bordered field; focus shifts to indigo with a soft ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="marketing for a restaurant" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 0.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #64748b; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(79,70,229,0.2); }

components.name: Tab / Pill
components.description: Segmented control. Active inverts to Signal Indigo fill.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-tab { background: #fff; color: #475569; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Inter, sans-serif; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #f8fafc; } .ds-tab-on { background: #4f46e5; border-color: #4f46e5; color: #fff; }

components.name: Eyebrow / Kicker
components.description: Mono uppercase micro-label. Signature but rationed — not above every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font: 500 0.6875rem/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #6366f1; margin: 0; }

components.name: Level Badge
components.description: Scoring band chip from the diverging ramp. Green means earned.
components.css: .ds-level { display: inline-block; font: 500 0.6875rem/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; } .ds-level-proficient { background: #e0f2fe; color: #075985; }

components.name: Breathing Target Loader
components.description: Concentric indigo rings pulsing outward around a center dot — the brand mark in motion. Keeps a slow pulse under reduced-motion.
components.css: .ds-loader { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 64px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-loader-ring { position: absolute; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.35); animation: ds-wave 2.8s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.2,1) infinite; } .ds-loader-ring:nth-child(1) { inset: 0; } .ds-loader-ring:nth-child(2) { inset: 12px; animation-delay: 0.15s; } .ds-loader-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(79,70,229,0.55); animation: ds-wave-dot 2.8s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.2,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-wave { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(0.68); } } @keyframes ds-wave-dot { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.2); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-loader-ring, .ds-loader-dot { animation-duration: 2.8s; } }

narrative.overview: PI Coach is where a DECA competitor rehearses the room before they're in it, so the interface carries the focus of game day without its dread. The feel is supportive, sharp, modern: a coach in the student's corner who is also exact enough to be believed. Indigo is the signal color against a cool slate canvas that stays quiet so the task can be loud. The system is built between two poles it refuses to become — not gamified or cartoonish, and not clinical exam software. Warmth comes from copy, spacing, and a coach's voice; sharpness from a precise type scale, a monospace data language, and an honest four-level scoring ramp.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo as a rationed signal on a cool slate canvas; color means status, never garnish.
One type system, three voices: Space Grotesk (display), Inter (text), JetBrains Mono (data/labels).
A diverging four-level scoring ramp (red → amber → sky → emerald) reserved for real assessment.
Flat by default, a gentle lift on hover; dark mode drops shadows for tonal layering.
Full light/dark parity; every animation has a reduced-motion path.

rules.name: The Rationed Indigo Rule
rules.body: Signal Indigo marks at most one primary action per view. If two things on a screen are indigo-filled, one is lying about its importance.

rules.name: The Earned-Green Rule
rules.body: The scoring ramp is the only place saturated red/amber/sky/emerald appear. Never borrow those hues for decoration.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Outside the hero H1, type is a fixed rem scale, not fluid clamps.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for numeric data and system labels. Never set prose or buttons in mono for flavor.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; a shadow appears only in response to hover, focus, or elevation.

rules.name: The Shadowless-Dark Rule
rules.body: In dark mode, no drop shadows. Separate layers by surface tone and hairline borders.

dos: Do ration Signal Indigo (#4f46e5) to one primary action per view; use Accent Indigo for smaller emphasis.
Do keep the scoring ramp (red → amber → sky → emerald) exclusively for assessment, so green always means earned.
Do set every score, weight, timer, and kicker in JetBrains Mono; keep prose in Inter and headings in Space Grotesk.
Do keep body text at Body Slate (#475569) or darker — it must clear 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.
Do let surfaces sit flat and lift only on hover/focus; in dark mode separate layers by tone, not shadow.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion path, never a hard freeze on essential feedback.
Do vary section rhythm around an 8rem base so the page feels hand-paced, not stamped.
donts: Don't use gradient text or gradient-filled buttons. Emphasis comes from weight, size, and a single solid Signal Indigo.
Don't stamp a mono uppercase eyebrow above every section. One deliberate kicker is voice; an eyebrow on every heading is AI grammar.
Don't ship identical card grids — same-size number/icon + heading + text repeated in a rigid grid-cols-3.
Don't drift gamified or cartoonish: no mascots, confetti, badge-grinding, or playful blobs.
Don't drift clinical or sterile: no standardized-test grays or proctoring-tool coldness.
Don't borrow the scoring hues for decoration, or use Novice Red / Exemplary Emerald as generic error/success garnish.
Don't nest a card inside a card, ever.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
